title: Add the reached dataset organizations and catalog lifecycle
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of dataset_catalog_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: All 23 runtime import definitions construct the owned generic dataset catalog: 13 keyed paths, six GDG bases, one initial generation, and three partitioned libraries with CTL/JCL/PRC member extensions.
GDG creation, current/relative resolution, limit roll, SCRATCH/NOEMPTY disposition, idempotent replay, retired-generation hiding, and provider restart are durable and bounded.
Partitioned member catalogs and ordered DD concatenation implement first-library member resolution; sequential concatenation preserves dataset/record order.

Reached ESDS NONINDEXED and RRDS NUMBERED definitions use exact 80-byte records. Entry-sequenced append and relative-number read/write/delete are typed rather than overloaded as sequential or keyed access.
Fixed, fixed-blocked, variable-blocked, and line-sequential records enforce LRECL and line boundaries; malformed or oversized records fail explicitly.

commands.result: focused pre-repair regression failed because ESDS/RRDS organizations were unrepresented
